fusions.name: Reach Across the Table
fusions.desc: A long reach with the rod that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Platter Service
fusions.desc: A cone 4 tiles long that deals 11 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Muddled] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Seconds All Round
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Full Belly
fusions.desc: When you gain health, you restore 6 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
